I'm a first-year MSPPM-DA student at Carnegie Mellon's Heinz College, working on
empirical questions in labor economics and education policy.

Before Heinz, I founded and ran the Office of Corporate Partnerships and Careers
at Plaksha University — building employer relationships and placement operations
from scratch for a new institution with no track record to trade on. That work is
what pushed me toward studying labor markets rather than operating inside one.

Earlier: gravitational-wave parameter estimation at IIT Madras on an IAS Summer
Research Fellowship, and a B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from
NIT Trichy.
